question: List the five 10° × 10° grid cells that contain the most airports, showing the lower‑left corner coordinates and the airport count.
sql: WITH grid AS ( SELECT i AS lat_idx, j AS lon_idx, ST_MakeEnvelope(j*10-180, i*10-90, (j+1)*10-180, (i+1)*10-90) AS geom FROM generate_series(0,17) i CROSS JOIN generate_series(0,35) j ) SELECT grid.lon_idx*10-180 AS lon_min, grid.lat_idx*10-90 AS lat_min, COUNT(a.*) AS airport_count FROM grid LEFT JOIN airports a ON ST_Contains(grid.geom, a.geometry) GROUP BY grid.lon_idx, grid.lat_idx ORDER BY airport_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Give the number of major airports in each continent (using rough continent bounding boxes).
sql: WITH continents AS ( SELECT 'North America' AS name, ST_MakeEnvelope(-168, 7, -52, 83) AS geom UNION ALL SELECT 'South America', ST_MakeEnvelope(-82, -56, -34, 13) UNION ALL SELECT 'Europe', ST_MakeEnvelope(-31, 35, 40, 71) UNION ALL SELECT 'Africa', ST_MakeEnvelope(-17, -35, 51, 38) UNION ALL SELECT 'Asia', ST_MakeEnvelope(26, -11, 180, 81) UNION ALL SELECT 'Oceania', ST_MakeEnvelope(110, -50, 180, 10) ) SELECT c.name, COUNT(a.*) AS major_airport_count FROM continents c LEFT JOIN airports a ON a.type = 'major' AND ST_Contains(c.geom, a.geometry) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name;

question: For each 10° × 10° grid cell, compute the average scalerank of airports that lie within 200 km of Los Angeles, and show cells that have at least one such airport.
sql: WITH grid AS ( SELECT i AS lat_idx, j AS lon_idx, ST_MakeEnvelope(j*10-180, i*10-90, (j+1)*10-180, (i+1)*10-90) AS geom FROM generate_series(0,17) i CROSS JOIN generate_series(0,35) j ), la_point AS ( SELECT ST_Point(-118.2437, 34.0522) AS geom ) SELECT grid.lon_idx*10-180 AS lon_min, grid.lat_idx*10-90 AS lat_min, AVG(a.scalerank) AS avg_scalerank FROM grid JOIN airports a ON ST_Contains(grid.geom, a.geometry) WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, (SELECT geom FROM la_point)) <= 200000 GROUP BY grid.lon_idx, grid.lat_idx HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY avg_scalerank DESC;

question: Show the top ten 5° × 5° grid cells by the sum of scalerank values of military airports.
sql: WITH grid AS ( SELECT i AS lat_idx, j AS lon_idx, ST_MakeEnvelope(j*5-180, i*5-90, (j+1)*5-180, (i+1)*5-90) AS geom FROM generate_series(0,35) i CROSS JOIN generate_series(0,71) j ) SELECT grid.lon_idx*5-180 AS lon_min, grid.lat_idx*5-90 AS lat_min, SUM(a.scalerank) AS total_scalerank FROM grid JOIN airports a ON ST_Contains(grid.geom, a.geometry) WHERE a.type LIKE '%military%' GROUP BY grid.lon_idx, grid.lat_idx ORDER BY total_scalerank DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Find the grid cell that has the highest number of airports whose IATA code starts with the letter ‘A’, and return the cell geometry as GeoJSON together with the count.
sql: WITH grid AS ( SELECT i AS lat_idx, j AS lon_idx, ST_MakeEnvelope(j*10-180, i*10-90, (j+1)*10-180, (i+1)*10-90) AS geom FROM generate_series(0,17) i CROSS JOIN generate_series(0,35) j ), filtered AS ( SELECT a.*, grid.lon_idx, grid.lat_idx, grid.geom FROM airports a JOIN grid ON ST_Contains(grid.geom, a.geometry) WHERE a.iata_code IS NOT NULL AND a.iata_code LIKE 'A%' ) SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(filtered.geom) AS cell_geojson, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM filtered GROUP BY filtered.lon_idx, filtered.lat_idx, filtered.geom ORDER BY airport_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Compare how many airports are in the Northern Hemisphere versus the Southern Hemisphere.
sql: WITH hemispheres AS ( SELECT 'Northern' AS hemi, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, 0, 180, 90) AS geom UNION ALL SELECT 'Southern', ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, -90, 180, 0) ) SELECT h.hemi, COUNT(a.*) AS airport_count FROM hemispheres h LEFT JOIN airports a ON ST_Contains(h.geom, a.geometry) GROUP BY h.hemi ORDER BY h.hemi;
